description: This file contains a serializer, surrogate, and copier implementations for handling the serialization and deep copying of ImmutableSortedSet<T> in Orleans. It defines a codec class, a surrogate struct, and a copier class specific to ImmutableSortedSet<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableSortedSet<T> using surrogate pattern.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Data contract (surrogate) for serializing ImmutableSortedSet<T> instances.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableSortedSet<T> to facilitate serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts the surrogate representation back into an ImmutableSortedSet<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableSortedSet<T> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableSortedSet<T> for serialization purposes.
